description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Temporarily stop taking new bookings (paused=true) or resume (paused=false). Existing bookings stay. Use it for a break of days or weeks; for a single day or a few hours use owner_block_time.

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

paused.description: True stops new bookings, false resumes them

name: owner_pause
title: Pause or resume bookings
